material_finding.current_semantics: explicit_cost selects the first finite value among fee/fees/slippage_cost/execution_cost/cost and the stress gate subtracts only that selected amount from terminal net PnL at the configured multiplier
missing_or_ambiguous_components: overlap semantics when execution_cost or cost is an aggregate rather than a disjoint component
material_finding.economic_risk: a terminal observation can remain positive under reported cost stress even when the same frozen observation is non-positive after all disjoint explicit execution costs are stressed

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: net_pnl is already net of the 1x baseline costs; the stress multiplier therefore charges only the incremental (multiplier-1) times baseline cost
deterministic_counterexample.note: This is a deterministic identification counterexample, not a claim about observed Polymarket PnL or about the exact cost fields emitted by every current producer. It shows the generic sidecar cannot prove full-cost robustness from its present schema.

ci_coverage_finding_on_base_main.materiality: PR #707 classifies this sidecar as a sensitive V7 evidence surface, but the focused regression suite for the #705 maturity-accounting fix is not part of the base-main CTest/explicit unittest path.

required_successor_contract: Define disjoint authoritative fee/slippage/unwind/capital/latency cost provenance, or one verified non-overlapping total-cost field with an explicit schema.
Reconstruct 1x realized PnL from audited cashflows and costs instead of trusting whichever generic cost field appears first.
Stress the same frozen realized observations at 1x, 1.5x and 2x without reselecting trades or completion states.
Fail closed when cost decomposition is missing, overlapping, ambiguous or unverifiable.
Keep the focused execution-evidence regression in required exact-head CI before any fill/PnL maturity gate is used for promotion.
